lesson.body_pose.title: Simple Body & Pose
lesson.body_pose.summary: Construct a simple figure with clear body proportions, then use direction and balance to give the pose more life.
lesson.body_pose.step.torso: Block in the torso and pelvis as two simple masses. Compare their width and the space between them.
lesson.body_pose.help.torso: Use the body axis and shoulder/hip guides to keep the masses related. They can tilt a little; they do not need to be perfectly level.
lesson.body_pose.complete.torso: The core body masses are established.
lesson.body_pose.step.limbs: Add arms and legs from the larger body shapes. Think about direction first, then length.
lesson.body_pose.help.limbs: Follow each limb from the shoulder or hip outward. Compare the bend and overall reach before refining the line.
lesson.body_pose.complete.limbs: The figure now has a complete limb structure.
lesson.body_pose.step.pose: Check the action line, shoulder angle and hip angle. Small changes here can make the whole figure feel more relaxed, active or balanced.
lesson.body_pose.help.pose: Look for one main direction through the body, then compare the shoulders and hips against it. Pose is a relationship, not a perfect measurement.
lesson.body_pose.complete.pose: The pose now has a clear direction and balance.
lesson.body_pose.step.contour: Refine the outer silhouette around the construction. Keep the big shape readable before adding any detail.
lesson.body_pose.help.contour: Step back mentally and compare the left and right edges of the figure. Keep the silhouette simple enough to read at a glance.
lesson.body_pose.complete.contour: The figure has a readable outer silhouette.
lesson.body_pose.step.variation: Make the pose yours. Change an arm, add a bag or prop, shift the action, or invent what the character is doing.
lesson.body_pose.help.variation: Choose one story idea first, then adjust the pose or accessory to support it. You do not need to match the teacher figure.
lesson.body_pose.complete.drawing: You used construction, proportion and pose to build your own figure.
